page.overview:
Who is Skreev?

was a slyborne human nightwalker rogue played by Liam O'Brien in Age of Umbra.

Skreev was a very gaunt, very tall and pale human man with scraggly white hair, one side shaved, wrapped in leather and black cloth strips except for a diamond-shaped window revealing a large silver ring threaded through the skin of his chest. Smaller rings were similarly threaded in his arms. He maintained a scrunched and skulking stance at most times. His leather hand wraps or gloves had iron claws protruding from them.

He displayed an erratic, chaotic, and extravagant behavior. However, he also had moments of unusual sweetness and formality, especially around Adelia. He seemed to have a sense of balance and compensation, treating others as he was treated and expecting the same in return. Despite his past psychological and physical trauma he tried to weaponize those feelings and sensations, owning his pain as a way of feeling in control.

Skreev used to live in Amber Reach, where he was abused and tortured by Farrah of the Ruby Crown, one of the Damask Queens. One day, in the ruins beneath the city, he met Adelia, a young girl who had been left alone and had been hiding there; he became her friend, protector, and "pet", and they started traveling together. Around a year later and about a week before the events of Age of Umbra, the two of them attended a revival meeting held by Sanctifar the Enlightened, a "holy man", and witnessed how he and his allies tricked people to join them and then allegedly killed them. Apparently to silence Adelia and Skreev, the Enlightened locked them up in cages, not far from Volkoru.
